## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Oct 7, 2026 - Oct 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _jade m_, Oct 10, 2026, 1/5: "!!!! Impossible to cancel Subscription !!! SCAM no refund , app has many bugs, I've tried unsuccessfully to cancel many times my subscription without succes , always brought me back to the same page over and over again . I barely ever use the app because I had to re enter all my information every single time I wanted to use the app and it got tiring, I have contacted costumers service and they are refusing refunds or help of any kind . DO NOT BUY ANY SUBSCRIPTION FROM THIS APP , DO NOT DO IT ,"
            2. _Brenda Bangalao_, Oct 8, 2026, 1/5: "Everything about this app is to be paid. I only intend to try if this app would be of help to me but you have to pay an initial amount to be able to see their offers and interface. Now they charge me again for something I did not subscribe. It's not even in my google play subscriptions or in their web. They know how to very well hide the subscription page so they can get money out of your card. And also their workout is not inspiring. The sound and voice recording is lame. 👎👎👎"
            3. _Pamela Henshaw_, Oct 7, 2026, 1/5: "UPDATE: I continue to get emails from customer service telling me to delete my review. Extremely DISAPPOINTED. I did the trial for this APP and canceled it quickly. Later I received a message stating that my trial period was over & Id be billed. I emailed my concerns and got a messages stating that my trial and subscription had already been canceled then next day got billed for it. Back & forth emails all stating that I was canceled now they are saying I hadn't canceled before I was billed."
